name: CausticContagion / dismemberment

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A sticky fibrous rip and two acidic bubble bursts, followed by alternating wet caustic sizzling and dry papery spore flutter, pulsing down together. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
